grid.anchor: AOI upper-left; matches accepted native Base_DTM grid
grid.pixel_rule: center for SIOSE IDs; all_touched for conservative building candidates

source_semantics.R: Observed low LiDAR class shading fallback, not planting permission
source_semantics.G: Observed medium/high class forest-floor shading fallback; invalid high rejected
source_semantics.B: Dated polygon open-rock share, not measured fine ground cover
source_semantics.A: Artistic dry-channel appearance along mapped water lines; NOT sample availability or water presence
source_semantics.placement: Original PCG selectors, reasons and clearance remain byte-identical and binding
source_semantics.neutral: Mineral remainder; slope fallback for zero RGB is artistic only
source_semantics.water: 1m half-width plus radius-2 pixel soft edge; excludes road/building pixels; not surveyed bed width, flow or flood extent

semantics.R: Low vegetation appearance, including bounded neighbor inference; no planting authority
semantics.G: Forest-floor appearance, including bounded neighbor inference; no planting authority
semantics.B: Rock appearance, including bounded neighbor inference; no new geology classification
semantics.A: Retained artistic dry-channel appearance, zero over pavement/buildings
semantics.neutral: Mineral residual 1-sum(RGB); all-zero RGB means mineral, not a hole
semantics.availability: Unchanged original observations; inferred pixels remain unknown
semantics.inference_kind: 0 observed, 1 neighbor fill, 2 neutral fallback, 3 protected road/building

recipe.sampling: linear data, bilinear for appearance only; placement remains nearest
